import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final boolean DEBUG = false;
    static final long INFFLUJO = (long)1e14;
    static final long INFCOSTO = (long)1e14;
    static final int MAXN = 50 * 100 + 15;
    static int SRC = MAXN - 1;
    static int SNC = MAXN - 2;
    static int total_nodes = MAXN;
    static List<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] dist = new long[MAXN];
    static long min_cost;
    static int[] predecessor = new int[MAXN];
    static long[] capacity = new long[MAXN];
    static long max_flow;
    static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[MAXN];

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        long cost;

        public Edge(int u, int v, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }

        long remaining() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, long capacity, long cost_value) {
        if (DEBUG) {
            String dem = Integer.toString(u);
            String pen = Integer.toString(v);
            if (u == SRC) dem = "SRC";
            if (u == SNC) dem = "SINC";
            if (v == SRC) pen = "SRC";
            if (v == SNC) pen = "SINC";
            System.out.println("add edge: " + dem + " " + pen + " " + capacity + " " + cost_value);
        }
        graph[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, capacity, 0, cost_value));
        graph[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost_value));
    }

    static void run_flow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        max_flow = 0;
        min_cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INFCOSTO);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(predecessor, -1);
            predecessor[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(capacity, 0);
            capacity[s] = INFFLUJO;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            in_queue[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                in_queue[u] = false;
                for (int i : graph[u]) {
                    Edge E = edges.get(i);
                    if (E.remaining() > 1e-9 && dist[E.v] > dist[u] + E.cost + 1e-9) {
                        dist[E.v] = dist[u] + E.cost;
                        predecessor[E.v] = i;
                        capacity[E.v] = Math.min(capacity[u], E.remaining());
                        if (!in_queue[E.v]) {
                            q.offer(E.v);
                            in_queue[E.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (predecessor[t] < 0) break;
            long flow = capacity[t];
            max_flow += flow;
            min_cost += flow * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = edges.get(predecessor[v]).u) {
                edges.get(predecessor[v]).flow += flow;
                edges.get(predecessor[v] ^ 1).flow -= flow;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long c = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long d = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        int MAXT = (int) (n + k);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        long[] a = new long[(int) k];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            a[i] = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            add_edge(SRC, (int) (a[i] * MAXT), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < MAXT; j++) {
            add_edge(j, SNC, k, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    add_edge(x * MAXT + j, y * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    add_edge(y * MAXT + j, x * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * K - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXT - 1; j++) {
                for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                    add_edge(i * MAXT + j, i * MAXT + j + 1, 1, c);
                }
            }
        }

        run_flow(SRC, SNC);
        if (DEBUG) {
            System.out.println("mincost: " + min_cost + " maxflow: " + max_flow);
        }
        System.out.println(min_cost);
    }
}
